agent_explanation: Single body falls under gravity and hits arena floor between steps 60 and 61. Incoming speed ~18.67 should rebound to at most e*speed ~16.9, but rebound speed is ~19.73, larger than impact. This super-elastic floor bounce injects ~346 J, pushing total energy from ~3017 to ~3363 and exceeding E0+10%+5. Likely cause: floor impulse applies restitution to already positionally-corrected / gravity-augmented velocity or double-applies bounce over substeps, creating energy instead of dissipating.
